notes: The head of οὔπω → not yet is the one genuinely open choice in the verse, and the unit's note names the competing head on not, which satisfies rule 16.

The supplied complementizer that goes to the expanded infinitive under rule 85 and the supplied subject he with it under rule 74, leaving δοκεῖ a bare thinketh; rule 74's closing aside is not read as a placement rule for the complementizer.
γνῶναι keeps its own infinitival to under rules 7 and 61, no conjunction or preposition governing the clause.
v001, v002 and v004 are underdetermined with the projection on r00-base, which the English permits; no textual decision is taken here (rule 12).
